# Situated worlds and geographical relations

Source/production setting, narrated setting and reception setting answer different questions. Each route below returns to its whole, where the telling, source house and relation-local interpretation remain available. Shared archetypal structuration is reached through [the archetypal ground](../../archetypal-ground/README.md); temporal sequence through [temporality](../temporality/README.md).

## Hellenic tellings

Homeric song and the Attic civic foundation remain distinct witnesses. Ares departs for Thrace and Aphrodite for Paphos; Attica retains the Athenian Acropolis and the competing signs.

- [Ares, Aphrodite, Harmonia, Eros, Hephaestus and Poseidon — the whole relation](../../worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.
- [Attica — Athena, Poseidon, Cecrops, Olive, Sea, Verdict, and the Remembered Counter-Claim](../../worlds/hellenic/attica-athena-poseidon-cecrops/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.

## Roman Latin tellings

Ovid and Apuleius supply different Latin works. Daphne’s pursuit and Psyche’s journey retain their own narrated places; a Greek divine cast does not change the selected Latin source.

- [Apollo · Eros/Cupid · Daphne · Peneus](../../worlds/roman-latin/apollo-eros-daphne-peneus/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.
- [Eros and Psyche](../../worlds/roman-latin/eros-psyche/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.

## Biblical Job

The biblical telling, Jung’s interpretation and Taylor’s three-office reading retain separate attribution. Job’s narrated land and divine council belong to the story; modern interpretive settings remain distinct.

- [Job](../../worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.

## Late-antique Gnostic worlds

The Hypostasis tractate and Irenaeus’s hostile report of Valentinian teaching are independent carriers. Codex transmission and the reporter’s historical location remain distinct from Pleroma, heavens and the embodied cosmos.

- [The Hypostasis of the Archons — Sophia, Veil, Rulers, Adam, Norea, Eleleth, and the Root Above](../../worlds/late-antique-gnostic/hypostasis-archons-norea-sophia/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.
- [Valentinian Sophia, Horos, Achamoth and Soter](../../worlds/late-antique-gnostic/valentinian-sophia-horos-achamoth/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.

## Chinese Huayan

The Dushun-attributed contemplation carries the jewel net; attribution remains disputed. Indra’s celestial setting and Indian name remain distinct from the Chinese Huayan doctrinal carrier.

- [Indra’s jewel net — the whole within each reflection](../../worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.

## Analytical psychology

Jung’s symbolic history and Pauli’s dream/commentary retain separate authors and source passages. Modern psychological production remains distinct from the many regions whose images Jung interprets and from Pauli’s dream scene.

- [Jung's Aion — Self, Christ/Antichrist, Fishes, Alchemy, and the Historical Shadow](../../worlds/analytical-psychology/jung-aion-fishes-christ-antichrist-alchemy/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.
- [Pauli's egg dream — spontaneous division, conscious participation and the circle](../../worlds/analytical-psychology/pauli-egg-dream/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.

## Francophone anticolonial encounter

Fanon’s situated racial-colonial inquiry retains its own speaking position. The Antilles and metropolitan French encounter are historical conditions of language, gaze and recognition.

- [Fanon — Language, White Gaze, Racialised Body, Mask, and Recognition](../../worlds/francophone-anticolonial/fanon-language-gaze-mask-recognition/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.

## German literature

Goethe’s poem remains a complete poetic movement in its German witness. The poem’s flowers, leaves, river and season are narrated images; its English reception does not relocate the authored work.

- [Goethe — Permanence in Change](../../worlds/german-literature/goethe-permanence-change/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.

## British television

The Prisoner is a television work with selected written episode tellings and an independently housed programme identity. The Village is a narrated confinement setting; the British production world is a different geographical relation.

- [The Prisoner — Number Six, the changing Two, and the question of One](../../worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md) — **attested-in** its own telling and source/reception distinctions.
